name: Saltspray
body:
School conjuration (creation) [water]; Level druid 0, shaman 0, witch 0

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range 40 ft.

Effect ray

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You fire a stream of saltwater at the target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target. The stream deals 1d3 points of damage. This spell deals 1d6 damage to slugs, plant creatures, and creatures primarily made of acid or weak to salt.
